sanskrit: marudbhyo 'śvibhyāṃ brahmaṇe brahmaṇaspataye 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi ||
english: To the Maruts, to the Aśvins, to Brahmaṇaspati the brahman — I cut away that son of so-and-so, the descendant of so-and-so.

sanskrit: ye svaś cakrur ye svar jajñuḥ | tebhyaḥ svaḥkṛdbhyaḥ svaḥkārebhyo 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi | te svaḥkṛtaḥ svaḥkārā amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putraṃ parā bhāvayantu ||
english: Those who made heaven, those who were born in heaven — from those makers of heaven, those creators of heaven, I cut away that son of so-and-so, the descendant of so-and-so. May those makers of heaven, those creators of heaven, drive that son of so-and-so, the descendant of so-and-so, away.

sanskrit: ye tapaś cakrur ye tapo jajñuḥ | tebhyas tapaskṛdbhyas tapaskārebhyo 'mum (…) | te tapaskṛtas tapaskārā amum (…) ||
english: Those who performed austerity, those who were born in austerity — from those performers of austerity, those practisers of austerity, I cut away that one [son of so-and-so, the descendant of so-and-so]. May those performers of austerity, those practisers of austerity, drive that one [away].

sanskrit: ye brahma cakrur ye brahma jajñuḥ | tebhyo brahmakṛdbhyo brahmakārebhyo 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi | te brahmakṛto brahmakārā amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putraṃ parā bhāvayantu ||
english: Those who made sacred knowledge, those who were born in sacred knowledge — from those makers of brahman, those creators of brahman, I cut away that son of so-and-so, the descendant of so-and-so. May those makers of brahman, those creators of brahman, drive that son of so-and-so, the descendant of so-and-so, away.

sanskrit: aghāriṇīm amūm aghaviddhāṃ vikeśīm apapratidhimāsoktīṃ devamanuṣyāḥ paśyantu | amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putraṃ rurudhuṣīm ||
english: May gods and men behold that woman — sinful, pierced by evil, with dishevelled hair, without a counterpart, speaking false words — as one who has caused that son of so-and-so, the descendant of so-and-so, to weep.

sanskrit: aliklavā gṛdhrāḥ kaṅkāḥ suparṇāḥ śvapadāḥ patatriṇaḥ | vayāṃsi śakunayo 'muṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasyādahane carantu ||
english: Crows, vultures, herons, eagles, dogs, and flying creatures — may birds and omens range about at the cremation of that son of so-and-so, the descendant of so-and-so.

sanskrit: tad āpaḥ pra vahata- -avadyaṃ ca malaṃ ca yat | yad duṣvapnyam ārima yad ṛcānṛtam ūdima ||
english: O Waters, carry away all that — the blame and the impurity — whatever evil dream we have experienced, whatever falsehood we have uttered in a verse.

sanskrit: āpaḥ sapta sravantīs tā no muñcaṃtv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: The seven flowing rivers — may they release us from sin.

sanskrit: muñcantu mā śapathyād atho varuṇyād uta | atho yamasya paḍbīśād viśvasmād devaduṣkṛtāt ||
english: May they release me from the guilt of a curse, and also from what pertains to Varuṇa; and from the foot-fetter of Yama, and from every sin against the gods.

sanskrit: jāmiśaṃsād duṣvapnyād druho mā muñcantu varuṇasya pāśāt ||
english: From slander of kin, from evil dream, from deceit — may they release me from the noose of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: mahyam indro varuṇo bṛhaspatiḥ savitā varca ādadhan ||
english: May Indra, Varuṇa, Bṛhaspati, and Savitṛ bestow brilliance upon me.

sanskrit: bhrātṛvyahaṃ sapatnaham asau me bhrātṛbhyo 'sau sapatnaḥ ||
english: I am the slayer of rivals, the slayer of foes; that one is my rival among my brothers, that one is my enemy.

sanskrit: taṃ hanmi taṃ duḥsvapnyena vidhyāmi tam anāyuṣṭayā vidhyāmi taṃ kṣapitāyavyena vidhyāmi tam adharāñcaṃ mṛtyupatham abhyapa nudāmi ||
english: I slay him; I pierce him with evil dream; I pierce him with short life; I pierce him with the arrow of diminishing vital substance; I thrust him downward along the path of death.

sanskrit: vidma te svapna janitraṃ pāpmanaḥ putro 'sy abhūtyā adhi jāto yamasya karaṇaḥ | taṃ tvā svapna tathā vidma | yo bhadraḥ svapnaḥ sa mama yaḥ pāpas taṃ dviṣate pra hiṇmaḥ | tam asmai gamayāmas tenainaṃ vidhyāmo 'bhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmo nirbhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmaḥ parābhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmo grāhyaiṇaṃ vidhyāmas tamasainaṃ vidhyāmo agna enaṃ kravyāda ā vṛśāmo devānām enaṃ ghoraiḥ krūraiḥ praiṣair abhi preṣyamo vaiśvāṇarasyainaṃ daṃṣṭrayor api dadhmaḥ ||
english: O Dream, we know your origin: you are the son of Sin, born from ill-fortune, the instrument of Yama. Thus do we know you, O Dream. Whatever dream is auspicious — that is mine; whatever is evil — that we send forth to the enemy. We direct it toward him; with it we pierce him; we pierce him with ill-fortune; we pierce him with utter loss of fortune; we pierce him with utter ruin; we pierce him with the seizure-demon; we pierce him with darkness; O Agni, we cut this enemy off for the flesh-devouring fire; we send him forth beset by the dreadful, cruel commands of the gods; we place him between the jaws of Vaiśvānara.

sanskrit: (…) janitraṃ grāhyāḥ putro 'si nirṛtyā adhi (…) ||
english: [O Dream, we know your origin:] you are the son of the seizure-demon, born from Nirṛti [— thus do we know you, O Dream; and whatever is evil we send to the enemy, directing it, piercing him with it].

sanskrit: (…) janitraṃ varuṇasya putro 'si varuṇānyā adhi (…) ||
english: [O Dream, we know your origin:] you are the son of Varuṇa, born from Varuṇānī [— thus do we know you, O Dream; and whatever is evil we send to the enemy].

sanskrit: (…) janitram ahnaḥ putro 'si rātryā adhi (…) ||
english: [O Dream, we know your origin:] you are the son of Day, born from Night [— thus do we know you, O Dream; and whatever is evil we send to the enemy].

sanskrit: (…) janitraṃ divas putro 'si bhūmyā adhi (…) ||
english: [O Dream, we know your origin:] you are the son of Sky, born from Earth [— thus do we know you, O Dream; and whatever is evil we send to the enemy].

sanskrit: (…) janitraṃ vanaspatīnāṃ putro 'sy oṣadībhyo 'dhi (…) ||
english: [O Dream, we know your origin:] you are the son of the forest trees, born from the healing plants [— thus do we know you, O Dream; and whatever is evil we send to the enemy].

sanskrit: (…) janitraṃ vānaspatyānāṃ putro 'si vīrudbhyo 'dhi (…) ||
english: [O Dream, we know your origin:] you are the son of the woodland growths, born from the creeping plants [— thus do we know you, O Dream; and whatever is evil we send to the enemy].

sanskrit: (…) janitraṃ tandriyāḥ putro 'si koṭīyā adhi (…) ||
english: [O Dream, we know your origin:] you are the son of languor, born from drowsiness [— thus do we know you, O Dream; and whatever is evil we send to the enemy].

sanskrit: (…) janitraṃ rakṣasāṃ putro 'sy abhvebhyo 'dhi (…) ||
english: [O Dream, we know your origin:] you are the son of the Rākṣasas, born from the fierce demons [— thus do we know you, O Dream; and whatever is evil we send to the enemy].

sanskrit: vidma te svapna janitraṃ gandharvāṇāṃ putro 'sy apsarobhyo adhi jāto yamasya karaṇaḥ | taṃ tvā svapna iti trīṇi ||
english: O Dream, we know your origin: you are the son of the Gandharvas, born from the Apsarases, the instrument of Yama. Thus do we know you, O Dream — [so runs this verse] three times.
